name: secure_endpoint_api_call
description: Call the Cisco Secure Endpoint (AMP for Endpoints) REST API. Blast radius: GET=low, POST/PUT/PATCH=medium, DELETE=destructive (metadata only, never blocks). v1 response rows are under data['data']; page with query_params {limit,offset} (limit max 500).

function.name: secure_endpoint_api_call
function.description:
Call the Cisco Secure Endpoint (AMP for Endpoints) REST API.

ONE regional host; auth resolved from Settings (v1 Basic or v3 OAuth). Supply only method + path (+ body/query). Returns {status_code,data,error,blast_radius}; check status_code < 400.

v1 ENVELOPE: rows under data['data']; totals under data['metadata']['results']['total']. Page with query_params {"limit":100,"offset":0} (limit max 500).

KEY PATHS (v1):
  GET    /v1/computers                          List endpoints; filter {"hostname[]":"..","group_guid[]":".."}
  GET    /v1/computers/{guid}                   Computer detail
  GET    /v1/computers/{guid}/trajectory        Activity timeline
  GET    /v1/computers/{guid}/isolation         Isolation status
  PUT    /v1/computers/{guid}/isolation         Start isolation; body {"comment":".."}
  DELETE /v1/computers/{guid}/isolation         Stop isolation
  PATCH  /v1/computers/{guid}                    Move group; body {"group_guid":".."}
  GET    /v1/events                             Security events; filter {"event_type[]":"..","start_date":"ISO8601"}
  GET    /v1/event_types                        Event type catalog
  GET    /v1/groups, /v1/groups/{guid}          Groups
  GET    /v1/policies, /v1/policies/{guid}      Policies
  GET    /v1/vulnerabilities                    Hosts with vulnerable apps
  GET    /v1/computers/{guid}/vulnerabilities   Per-host vulns
  GET    /v1/file_lists, /v1/file_lists/{guid}/files   Allow/block lists
  POST   /v1/file_lists/{guid}/files/{sha256}   Add SHA256
  DELETE /v1/file_lists/{guid}/files/{sha256}   Remove SHA256
  GET    /v1/version                            Sanity check

NOTES: connector_guid identifies a computer; find it via GET /v1/computers first. Dates ISO-8601 UTC.

query_params.description: URL query parameters as key-value pairs (optional, e.g. {"limit": 100})
